_comment: Synthesized rules accumulated from weekly retrospectives. Updated at end of each scanner/retrospective/YYYYMMDD/ — append-only with conflict resolution. Read by /scanner Phase 0 step 8 and applied during Phase 2 selection.
_methodology:
Append-only. Each rule cites the retros that triggered it. Conflict resolution: most recent retro wins.

  Severity levels:
  - 'hard_block' = encoded in scanner-filters.json + validate-scan.js to refuse publication outright. Scan FAILS validation if violated.
  - 'selection_filter' = Claude applies the rule when CHOOSING the top 10 candidates at Phase 2. validate-scan.js surfaces violations as WARNINGS that should be fixed before publish.
  - 'advisory' = Claude biases selection (e.g. weight Pre-Squeeze higher in EARLY RISK-OFF) but a deviation is acceptable with rationale.
  - 'infrastructure' = always-on execution logic in sweep.js/signal-monitor.js, not a selection rule.
  - 'deprecated' = rule is no longer active, kept for historical context.

  v2.0 UPGRADE NOTES (20260619 audit):
  - Promoted regime-score-label-lag from advisory to hard_block (prevented D* grade week)
  - Promoted rr-min-by-regime from selection_filter to hard_block (100% violation rate with zero enforcement)
  - Promoted stopped-ticker-cooldown from selection_filter to hard_block (RIO double loss pattern)
  - Deprecated energy-early-risk-off-sizing (redundant with energy-early-risk-off-block)
  - Added 12 new rules from audit of 17 retros
  - All '?' values resolved, all rules have complete field sets

rules.rule: Stop minimum 1.5x ATR(14) du ticker. JAMAIS de stop < 3% absolu, JAMAIS > 8%. Applies to ALL strategies including Candlestick.
invalidation_conditions: If Candlestick or any strategy is found to bypass the 3-8% / 1.5x ATR band check again after a validate-scan.js audit, escalate to infra bug not policy issue.
rules.notes: Enforce minimum stop distance of 1.5x ATR(14) with absolute bounds of 3-8% from entry. Prevents intraday noise stops and degenerate tight/loose bands. | Rationale: Stops < 1.5x ATR triggered intraday before rebound (VRT -7.9%, COP -3.5%, COST -3.0%, IBM). Candlestick signals bypassed the check: QURE 44.66% stop, GRAF 0.55% stop published in 20260617-20260622 despite being far outside the 3-8% range.

rules.rule: R/R minimum (H10): RISK-ON 1:1.5, NEUTRAL 1:1.5, EARLY RISK-OFF 1:2.0, RISK-OFF 1:2.0. For H15+, NEUTRAL/RECOVERY R/R can target 1:1.7. validate-scan.js must emit VIOLATION (not advisory). Regime-horizon linkage: RISK-ON/NEUTRAL default to H10, EARLY RISK-OFF/RISK-OFF extend to H15.
invalidation_conditions: See _open_questions:tp1-calibration-hit-rate-improvement — if TP1 hit-rate does not improve after review at 2026-07-04, revisit the 1.5R calibration.
rules.notes: Enforce minimum risk/reward ratio per regime and horizon. H10: RISK-ON 1:1.5, NEUTRAL 1:1.5, EARLY RISK-OFF 1:2.0, RISK-OFF 1:2.0. H15+: NEUTRAL/RECOVERY 1:1.7. Harmonized with tp1-horizon-calibration: RISK-ON/NEUTRAL use H10, ERO/RO extend to H15. | Rationale: 20260618 scan: ALL 10 signals at R/R 1:1.7 in EARLY RISK-OFF requiring 1:2.0 -- 100% violation rate with zero enforcement. Lowered NEUTRAL from 1.7 to 1.5 because 87%+ of H10 setups expire positive without hitting 1.7R TP1 (evidence: 6 retros). Setting R/R=1.5 with TP1=1.5R for H10 maximizes TP1 hit rate.

rules.rule: When regime label rank exceeds score-implied rank by 2+ levels, validate-scan.js emits a HARD VIOLATION blocking publication. Score < 50 with RISK-ON label = at minimum NEUTRAL; score < 40 = EARLY RISK-OFF regardless of label. 2+ consecutive scans below 50 triggers strategy weight override: Momentum capped at 20%.
invalidation_conditions: See _closed_questions:regime-hard-block-impact — score dropped to 28.8 with 22 stops/37 resolved in week 20260626 despite hard_block; monitor 2 more retros before declaring fully effective.
rules.notes: When regime score drops below 50 for 2+ consecutive scans while label remains RISK-ON, treat regime as NEUTRAL effective. Block publication if label diverges 2+ levels from score-implied regime. | Rationale: Jun 1-3 2026: score 58->47->41 but label stayed RISK-ON. 8 Momentum entries stopped in <=2 days (AMZN -3.85%, LLY -3.15%, GOOGL -2.04%, PLTR -4.83%). Jun 17: RISK-ON label with score 40 (EARLY RISK-OFF territory) passed validation as advisory only. This single change would have prevented the D* grade week (20260612) and the 8-stop cascade.

rules.rule: If a ticker was stopped in the last 3 scans, it is EXCLUDED from Phase 2 selection for 5 trading days. validate-scan.js checks signals.json[-3] + resolved trades for stopped status. Additionally, any ticker appearing in 3+ consecutive scans is blocked regardless of stop status.
invalidation_conditions: See _closed_questions:stopped-ticker-cooldown-effectiveness — only 1 week of post-hard_block data (20260626); monitor 2 more retros.
rules.notes: Block re-selection of stopped tickers for 5 trading days. Prevents compounding losses from consecutive-scan re-entries on the same name. | Rationale: RIO stopped 16/06 (breakout -4.13%) then re-selected 17/06 (pullback -2.65%) = -6.78% cumulative on one name. GDX selected 2x at -2.82% and -5.16% MtM. SAN appeared in 4 consecutive scans. The rule was created AFTER the violation (20260619) and was only selection_filter -- audit demands hard_block.

rules.rule: If forced_regime_label diverges > 0.2 from ensemble probability AND a binary catalyst (FOMC, NFP, CPI, geopolitical) is within 48h, BLOCK the override. validate-scan.js must reject scans with forced regime labels.
rules.notes: Block manual regime overrides that diverge >0.2 from ensemble model near binary catalysts. Forced RISK-ON against ensemble NEUTRAL caused the D* week. | Rationale: Jun 4 scan forced RISK-ON 0.87 against ensemble NEUTRAL, producing 15 stops on 19 resolved signals. This single override caused the worst-ever D* grade (20260612). Impact score 10 -- the most damaging single event in scanner history.

rules.rule: Short Squeeze EXCLU de toutes les strategies. Strategies autorisees UNIQUEMENT: Momentum, Pre-Squeeze, Breakout, Pullback, Candlestick.
invalidation_conditions: 0% WR was observed across Feb-Mar 2026 only (2 months); exact trade count not recorded in original rule text — see _open_questions backfill entry.
rules.notes: Short Squeeze strategy is permanently banned. 0% win rate across Feb-Mar 2026 retros. | Rationale: 0% WR documented across 2 consecutive months. Dead strategy.

rules.rule: abs(entry - spot_price) / spot_price > 0.10 -> REJECT. Entry must be validated against real-time market price at Phase 2.
rules.notes: Reject setups where entry price diverges >10% from current spot. Catches stale cache, pre-split prices, and data errors. | Rationale: 25% of early setups had entry prices diverging >10% from market (ADBE at $430 vs real $260, ADP at $303 vs $216). Stale cache or pre-split prices feeding the scanner. Impact score 9. | Classified process_rule: this is a data-integrity check (stale cache / pre-split price detection), not a claim about market behavior — same family as no-hallucination guardrails.

rules.rule: abs(entry - stop) / ATR14 < 0.5 -> REJECT. close_at_scan > tp1 -> REJECT as stale entry. FCX 0.5% band, KRSP/RDAG 2-4 cents stops produce rule-resolved trades with no predictive value.
rules.notes: Reject setups with entry-stop band < 0.5x ATR14 or where closing price at scan time already exceeds TP1 (stale entry). | Rationale: Degenerate stop distances produce trades resolved by noise, not signal. FCX had a 0.5% band, PAYO 0.57%, GRAF 0.55% too tight; QURE 44.66%, NMRA 46.79% too loose. The 3-8% range check was bypassed by Candlestick signals. | Classified process_rule: rejects malformed/degenerate technical setups (garbage-in-garbage-out), not a decaying market-behavior claim.

rules.rule: if horizon <= 10 then tp1_distance <= 1.5 * risk_distance; if horizon > 10 then tp1_distance <= 2.0 * risk_distance. Regime-horizon linkage: RISK-ON/NEUTRAL default to H10 (R/R 1.5, TP1 1.5R), EARLY RISK-OFF/RISK-OFF extend to H15 (R/R 2.0, TP1 2.0R). Encode in scanner-filters.json and validate-scan.js.
invalidation_conditions: See _open_questions:tp1-calibration-hit-rate-improvement, review 2026-07-04.
rules.notes: TP1 must be calibrated to horizon. H10 -> TP1 at 1.5R max, H15+ -> TP1 at 2R max. Regime-horizon linkage: RISK-ON/NEUTRAL use H10 (TP1 max 1.5R), EARLY RISK-OFF/RISK-OFF use H15 (TP1 max 2.0R). | Rationale: Most persistently identified gap across 6 retros. 87%+ setups expire positive without hitting TP1 in H10 horizon. Harmonized with rr-min-by-regime: lowering NEUTRAL R/R from 1.7 to 1.5 and capping TP1 at 1.5R for H10 means realistic targets that actually get hit. For higher-risk regimes, extending horizon to H15 with 2.0R targets preserves the asymmetry needed.

rules.rule: score < 80 -> REJECT from top_10. If fewer than 10 candidates above 80, reduce scan size rather than dilute quality.
rules.notes: Minimum composite score of 80 for top 10 selection. Setups under 75 have systematically underperformed. | Rationale: Setups under score 75 have systematically underperformed across multiple retros. Quality floor prevents bottom-of-barrel picks from diluting the top 10.

rules.rule: if regime_score < 50: max 1 crypto-momentum signal, max 2 metals signals per scan. WLD/NEAR/INJ and FCX/SCCO/COPX must be treated as correlated pools.
invalidation_conditions: See _open_questions:correlated-pool-detection — cap currently relies on a hardcoded pool list (WLD/NEAR/INJ, FCX/SCCO/COPX), not dynamic correlation detection; review 2026-07-04.
rules.notes: Treat correlated asset pools (crypto, metals) as single positions for sizing. Cap exposure when regime score < 50. | Rationale: WLD/NEAR/INJ (crypto) and FCX/SCCO/COPX (metals) were stopped in bloc during the same shock in the D* week. Correlated pools amplify drawdown when they move together. Impact score 8.

rules.rule: if regime favors energy/commodity and candidate is tech/growth breakout -> score -= 10. if regime favors tech/growth and candidate is defensive/commodity -> score -= 10. FSLR solar in oil rally, tech momentum in Risk-Off all failed.

params.condition: sector misaligned with dominant regime theme

rules.notes: Apply score penalty (-10 to -15) to sectors misaligned with dominant regime theme. Counter-theme sectors fail systematically. | Rationale: Counter-theme sectors fail systematically across 4 retros. FSLR solar in oil rally failed, tech momentum in Risk-Off failed. Sector-regime alignment is a necessary condition for setup success.

rules.rule: if ticker in top_3_previous_retro AND pullback_from_recent_high < 10% -> REJECT.
rules.notes: Require minimum 10% pullback before re-entering a ticker that was in the top 3 of the previous retro. Prevents chasing extended winners. | Rationale: AG re-entered at $31 after +32% run, got stopped at -11.3%. Extended winners need a meaningful pullback before re-entry offers a valid risk/reward.

rules.rule: if VIX > 28: min 5 of 10 signals must be defensive/commodity/hedge sector. Tech and EU ETF momentum suspended until VIX < 22.
rules.notes: When VIX > 28, force minimum 5/10 picks to be defensive/commodity/short-hedge. Suspend tech and EU ETF momentum until VIX < 22. | Rationale: VIX > 28 = Full Defensive Tilt. During Mar 3-13 Risk-Off (VIX >25), Defensive/Hedge had 100% hit rate while EU/Asia ETFs had 0%. Impact score 8.

rules.rule: if count(scanner-positions.json.open_positions) >= 12 then max_new_setups = 5.
rules.notes: When open positions >= 12, reduce new setups to 5. Portfolio crowding degrades scan quality. | Rationale: Apr 16 scan quality degraded from portfolio crowding. The A* grade week (20260417) was achieved with focused 50-signal scans, not 80-90 signal bloat.

rules.rule: if early_risk_off_prob > 0.40 AND strategy == Breakout -> REJECT. Breakout in EARLY RISK-OFF produced stops in 3+ consecutive retros.
rules.notes: Block Breakout strategy in EARLY RISK-OFF. Institutional buyers step back and liquidity thins in risk-off transitions. | Rationale: Breakout hit rate in EARLY RISK-OFF: 0% (20260515), 0% (20260403). Institutional buyers step back during risk-off transitions, leaving breakout entries without follow-through liquidity. Impact score 7.

rules.rule: if regime in [EARLY RISK-OFF, RISK-OFF]: max 1 Pullback per scan; any regime: max 2 of same strategy per scan.
rules.notes: Cap same-strategy signals per scan: max 1 Pullback in EARLY RISK-OFF, max 2 of any single strategy in any regime. | Rationale: LLY+DE double stop on same day caused by 2 pullback entries in EARLY RISK-OFF. Correlated strategy exposure amplifies single-factor losses.

rules.rule: if same regime label for >= 3 consecutive sessions -> apply regime-specific strategy caps (Pullback near-zero in sustained EARLY RISK-OFF). Check signals.json[-3] for consecutive regime labels.
rules.notes: Check regime persistence before placing pullback entries. Transient EARLY RISK-OFF (1-2 days) creates opportunities; structural (3+ days) destroys them. | Rationale: Transient EARLY RISK-OFF creates pullback opportunities but structural EARLY RISK-OFF (3+ days) produces mean-reversion failures. Regime persistence matters more than regime label.

rules.rule: if ticker appeared in 3+ of last 5 scans -> score -= 5 * (appearances - 2). SAN in 4 consecutive scans is the reference violation.
rules.notes: Penalize tickers appearing in 3+ consecutive scans. Exhausted momentum produces diminishing returns. | Rationale: SAN in 4 consecutive scans, RIO/GDX in 2 consecutive scans. When a ticker fails after repeated picks, double-exposure compounds losses. Frequency across 4 retros.

rules.rule: if sector in [Materials, Industrials] AND strategy == Breakout AND macro_headwind_detected (tariff escalation, China PMI contraction, VIX > 25) -> score -= 10.
rules.notes: Gate materials/industrials breakouts on macro alignment. CLF, FCX collapsed on tariff/China demand headwinds. | Rationale: CLF, FCX collapsed on tariff/China demand headwinds. Materials/industrials breakouts without macro tailwind are fragile. Frequency across 3 retros.

rules.rule: If regime changed >= 2x in last 5 scanner days: reduce sizing 30% + widen stops x1.5 ATR. Detected via data/scanner.json[-5].regime comparison.
invalidation_conditions: Rule audited as "dead letter" as of 20260619 — 4 regime changes across 4 consecutive scans produced no sizing reduction. Re-verify enforcement is wired before trusting this rule's effect.
rules.notes: When regime changes 2+ times in 5 scanner days, reduce position size 30% and widen stops 1.5x ATR on all new setups. | Rationale: Week 20260518-22 had 4 rotations RECOVERY->RISK-ON->EARLY R-OFF->RISK-ON in 5 days. Breakouts/Momentum entered in quickly-invalidated conditions bled out. Audit found this rule is dead letter -- 20260617 scan showed no sizing reduction despite 4 regime changes across 4 consecutive scans.

rules.rule: Maximum 1 high-beta AI infra setup per scan in RECOVERY/EARLY RISK-OFF. Hard block if distance_50dma_pct exceeds 2x strategy cap (ARM at 59.6% vs 20% cap = 3x limit should hard-block). RSI > 72 daily = hard block.
rules.notes: Limit high-beta AI infra setups to max 1 per scan in RECOVERY or EARLY RISK-OFF. Block if RSI > 72 or distance from 50-DMA exceeds 2x strategy cap. | Rationale: VRT 20260518 (RECOVERY, +38% above 50-DMA, RSI 75) crashed -7.9%. ARM at 59.6% above 50-DMA (cap 20% for Momentum) published without block. INTC at 34.1% (cap 25%), HIMS at 34.8% -- all published without block. The overextension checks generate advisory only, never violations.

rules.rule: Trailing stop ne s'active pas avant 50% du parcours vers TP1 quand R/R initial >= 1:2.4.
invalidation_conditions: Not independently verifiable from signals.json alone — confirm via modes-config v5.2+ trailing implementation, not scanner selection data.
rules.notes: Trailing stop does not activate before 50% of the path to TP1 when initial R/R >= 1:2.4. Prevents premature exit on strong breakouts. | Rationale: Trailing too early on high-R/R breakouts cuts the distribution tail. Already encoded in modes-config v5.2+ for balanced/secured. Working as designed but not verifiable from signals.json alone.

rules.rule: RISK-ON continu >= 2j: Momentum 45%, Breakout 30%. EARLY RISK-OFF: Breakout 40%, Pullback 30%, Momentum 20%. Claude MUST respect these weights -- audit found 80% Momentum in EARLY RISK-OFF (20260618) vs 20% target.
invalidation_conditions: Audit found 80% Momentum allocation in EARLY RISK-OFF (20260618) vs 20% target — weights are advisory-in-practice despite selection_filter severity; needs an enforcement mechanism, not just a Phase 2 guideline.
rules.notes: In sustained RISK-ON (2+ days), target 45% Momentum / 30% Breakout. In EARLY RISK-OFF, invert: 40% Breakout, 30% Pullback, 20% Momentum. | Rationale: Retro 20260425: Momentum > Breakout under sustained RISK-ON (HR 65% vs 45%). But 20260617-18: 60-80% Momentum allocation in weak regimes (score 40) completely ignored the regime-based weights. Claude overrides these weights without consequence.

rules.rule: Si regime = EARLY RISK-OFF et compression volatilite detectee (bbw < hhv20(bbw)*0.6), allouer 25% du top 10 a Pre-Squeeze.
invalidation_conditions: Never enforced in practice as of 20260618 (0/10 Pre-Squeeze signals in an EARLY RISK-OFF scan) despite the 70% HR evidence — rule exists on paper but is not being applied at Phase 2.
rules.notes: Allocate 25% of top 10 to Pre-Squeeze when regime is EARLY RISK-OFF and volatility compression detected. | Rationale: Retro 20260502: Pre-Squeeze HR 70% in EARLY RISK-OFF -- best strategy for that regime. But 20260618 is EARLY RISK-OFF with 0/10 Pre-Squeeze signals. Rule has never been enforced in recent scans.

rules.rule: Aucun ticker avec earnings dans +/-3 jours de bourse. DISQUALIFICATION dure.
rules.notes: Hard disqualification for any ticker with earnings within 3 trading days. No exceptions. | Rationale: TimesFM accuracy drops to 40% (vs 56% baseline) near earnings. Multiple retros confirmed disastrous hit rate on setups near the print. Working as intended -- all recent signals have earnings_clear=true. | Classified process_rule: forecast-model reliability boundary (TimesFM accuracy 40% vs 56% baseline near earnings) — a structural data/model-trust guardrail, not a regime-conditioned market-behavior claim subject to decay.

rules.rule: DISQUALIFICATION immediate si SEC filing (S-1, S-3, 424B) < 90j mentionne aggressive underwriter (H.C. Wainwright, Maxim, Roth Capital, Ladenburg, Dawson James, Aegis, EF Hutton, Boustead).
rules.notes: Immediate disqualification if recent SEC filing (<90 days) mentions aggressive underwriters. Prevents micro/small-cap dilution traps. | Rationale: INDO 20260406 diluted 80% of float within 30 days -- toxic fund + ITM warrants. Working as intended -- all recent signals have dilution_clear=true. | Classified process_rule: compliance/legal blacklist screen (named toxic underwriters), a structural risk-avoidance control rather than a statistical market edge that decays.

rules.rule: Entry effective = min(open_next_session, VWAP_next_session) clamped a day_low. Si open > entry_high * 1.02, fill uniquement a VWAP pullback.

params.fill_condition: open > entry_high*1.02 => fill only at VWAP pullback

evidence.notes: 14 gap-up traps avoided, 31% no-fill rate observed 20260619 — not raw trade win/loss counts.

rules.notes: Entry effective = min(open_next_session, VWAP_next_session) clamped to day_low. Gap-up > 2% triggers VWAP pullback fill only. | Rationale: Sweep optimization validated +29% PnL, +16pp WR, 2.5x PF (commit 91596bd9). Protected the book from 14 gap-up traps in 20260619 retro (31% no-fill rate). Always-on infrastructure. | Classified process_rule: deterministic always-on execution/fill mechanics implemented in sweep.js/signal-monitor.js, not a selection-time market belief (per original methodology: "infrastructure = always-on execution logic, not a selection rule").

rules.rule: Top 10: 5 US + 2 EU + 1 APAC + 2 ETFs. Max 3 setups par secteur. Max 3 repeats vs scan precedent.
rules.notes: Minimum diversification: 5 US + 2 EU + 1 APAC + 2 ETFs, max 3 per sector, max 3 repeats vs previous scan. | Rationale: Sector concentration = principal correlated drawdown vector. max_per_sector is hard_block; country floors are selection_filter.

rules.rule: DISQUALIFIER tout setup Energy quand GetRegimeProbability early_risk_off > 0.30.
rules.notes: Disqualify all Energy sector setups when early_risk_off probability > 0.30. Energy crashes systematically in EARLY RISK-OFF windows. | Rationale: 3 consecutive retros: COP -3.51%, TTE -2.47%, plus similar patterns. Energy sector = -5.98% avoidable losses. 20260618 EARLY RISK-OFF had no energy signals, suggesting Claude applied the rule, but validate-scan.js has no safety net.

rules.rule: En RISK-ON > 70 confidence, si open > entry_high * 1.01, attendre pullback -0.3% depuis l'open.
invalidation_conditions: BE rate found to be 0% in the follow-up period (update 20260606), confirming the original 40% BE rate was specific to the May regime-oscillation week, not a persistent pattern — urgency of this rule may be overstated.
rules.notes: In high-confidence RISK-ON (>70), wait for -0.3% intraday pullback before entering gap-up setups. Urgency reduced after 0% BE rate follow-up. | Rationale: RISK-ON 85 (May 26-28) produced mostly breakevens. UPDATE 20260606: BE rate 0% on following period, confirming 40% was specific to May regime oscillation. Rule active as guard but urgency reduced. No infrastructure implementation.

rules.rule: Quand regime change >= 2x dans 5 derniers jours: (a) mcap < $2B -> REJECT sauf TKL pool; (b) mcap $2B-$10B -> sizing x0.5 + stops x1.5 ATR; (c) mcap $10B-$50B -> sizing x0.7 (stacks with regime-rotation-penalty); (d) mcap >= $50B -> normal sizing. Commodity/small-cap max 2 par scan en oscillation. Rule does NOT apply when regime-rotation-penalty is already reducing sizing 30%+ AND overextension-check is active — avoid triple-stacking.
invalidation_conditions: Explicit war-room revert condition (20260619, confidence 88%): revert to hard $20B floor if the next 3 oscillation retros show sub-$20B trades averaging worse than -6% per stop. Original $50B floor was N=3 (TSM/MS/ARM), confounded by sector effects (COP/TTE were energy losses, not mcap-driven).
rules.notes: When regime oscillated 2+ times in 5 days: tiered mcap sizing. Sub-$2B hard-blocked, $2-10B sizing x0.5 + stops x1.5 ATR, $10-50B sizing x0.7, $50B+ normal. Commodity/small-cap max 2 per scan. | Rationale: War room 20260619 (5 experts + adversarial + synthesis, confidence 88%): original $50B floor derived from N=3 observation (TSM/MS/ARM) confounded by sector effects (COP/TTE losses = energy, not mcap). BTBT 0.00%. Three of top 5 all-time trades are sub-$10B (SM +14.76%, CHRD +12.68%, BBIO +11.64%). 6 other rules already stack during oscillation. Tiered approach preserves the valid insight (mega-caps safer in oscillation) while keeping alpha-generating $5-50B universe accessible. Revert to hard floor $20B if next 3 oscillation retros show sub-$20B averaging worse than -6% per stop.

rules.rule: Pullback UNIQUEMENT si regime confidence > 60%. En regime oscillant (confidence < 60%), Pullback -> remplacer par Momentum ou Breakout.
rules.notes: Pullback strategy only allowed when regime confidence > 60%. In oscillating regime, replace Pullback with Momentum or Breakout. | Rationale: Pullback 0% WR on 20260519-29. RIO Pullback in 20260617 with regime score 40 (well below 60% confidence) -- the rule should have blocked this but was ignored. Audit recommends upgrade from advisory.

rules.rule: score >= 93 AND rsi14 < 55 -> REJECT.
rules.notes: Reject signals with score >= 93 AND RSI14 < 55. High score + weak price action = value trap. | Rationale: Backtest v8: 0 winners, 2 losers on resolved trades matching this pattern. Zero false positives. Narrow but functional.

rules.rule: strategy == Momentum AND rsi14 in [40,50] -> REJECT (except turbo mode).

evidence.notes: 7 losers saved / 1 winner lost = filter precision, not raw strategy WR.

rules.notes: For Momentum strategy, reject if RSI14 between 40-50. Directional limbo with no momentum edge. | Rationale: Backtest v8: 7 losers saved, 1 winner lost (7:1 ratio). EXCEPTION: skip for turbo (LMT false positive).

rules.rule: source == tkl_pool AND (price < 5 OR score < 88) -> REJECT.
rules.notes: TKL pool minimum quality: price >= $5, score >= 88. Prevents penny stock day-1 blowups. | Rationale: Backtest v8: 8 day-1 stop-losses at avg -7% = -5.63% portfolio impact prevented.

rules.rule: Si close > entry * 1.02 au moment Phase 2, proposer entree ajustee (VWAP estime J+1) ou exclure. Cible: no-fill rate < 15%.

evidence.notes: 14/45 (31%) no-fill due to Iran ceasefire rally 20260619.

invalidation_conditions: See _closed_questions:no-fill-rate-reduction — inconclusive after 20260626 (no equivalent rally week to test against); no infra enforcement yet, review 2026-07-04.
rules.notes: If closing price exceeds entry by >2% at Phase 2 time, adjust entry to estimated VWAP J+1 or exclude. Reduces no-fill waste. | Rationale: 14/45 signals (31%) no-fill due to Iran ceasefire rally. Gap-ups > 2% are predictable when SPX gained > 2% the prior day. Pre-filtering reduces slot waste. No infrastructure implementation yet.

rules.rule: Quand regime change >= 1x dans 3 derniers jours: sizing x0.7 sur tickers ATR/prix > 4%.

params.condition: regime changed >=1x in last 3 days AND ATR/price > 4%

rules.notes: Reduce sizing by 0.7x on tickers with ATR relative > 4% when regime oscillated in last 3 days. | Rationale: SAIA (ATR 22.66 = 4.8% relative) produced -7.01% -- largest loss of week 20260615-18. High absolute ATR amplifies per-position drawdown in oscillating regime. No enforcement metadata visible in signals.

rules.rule: Si EARLY RISK-OFF ET tickers Energy encore presents, sizing x0.5.
invalidation_conditions: Deprecated 20260619: redundant with energy-early-risk-off-block — if the block works, this never triggers; if the block fails, this advisory also fails.
rules.notes: DEPRECATED: Reduce energy sizing to x0.5 in EARLY RISK-OFF. Redundant with energy-early-risk-off-block which prevents energy entirely. | Rationale: Redundant. If energy-early-risk-off-block works, energy never appears and this rule never triggers. If the block fails, this advisory also fails. Audit recommends removal.

rules.rule: Si early_risk_off_prob > 0.40, allouer minimum 3/10 setups a healthcare/staples/utilities. Healthcare Momentum a 67% WR vs 18% Breakout dans la semaine du 16-26 juin.
invalidation_conditions: See _open_questions:healthcare-ero-tilt-effectiveness, review 2026-07-04.
rules.notes: Healthcare/defensive setups outperform during EARLY RISK-OFF transitions. Allocate 30%+ of top 10 to healthcare/staples when ERO probability exceeds 0.40. | Rationale: Week 20260616-26: Healthcare momentum (HIMS +13.49%, AAL +12.01%) outperformed while cyclical breakouts (RBLX -7.96%, AVGO -7.77%) collapsed during the ERO transition. Healthcare beta < 0.7 provides natural downside protection during regime deterioration.

rules.rule: Si VIX a monte de >3pts dans les 5 derniers jours: Breakout score -= 15. WR Breakout 18% vs Momentum 55% pendant la semaine du 16-26 juin avec VIX en hausse.
invalidation_conditions: See _open_questions:breakout-vol-penalty-calibration — magnitude of -15 not yet validated as correctly calibrated (could be too aggressive), review 2026-07-04.
rules.notes: Breakout strategy WR drops to 18% when VIX rises >3pts intraweek. Apply score penalty -15 on Breakout setups during rising-vol weeks. | Rationale: Breakout requires follow-through buying which evaporates when volatility rises. 18% WR on Breakout (vs 55% Momentum) is the worst strategy divergence observed. Breakout entries get trapped above resistance when vol spikes trigger profit-taking.

rules.rule: Tout enrichissement point-in-time mis en cache pour une RÉTROSPECTIVE (ou un staging dtx rejoué) DOIT encoder l as-of (end_date) dans la clé de cache — jamais une clé ticker-only servie à une date historique. Un cache `${ticker}` (ou `${type}-${country}-today`) servi à une rétro d as-of D peut renvoyer un filing/rapport/fondamental POSTÉRIEUR à D = look-ahead (leçons IOVA/INDO). Clé PIT: `${ticker}:${asof}` / `${type}-${country}-${asof}` / chemin daté (price-cache.js). Côté MCP, borner serveur: GetInstruments(as_of=D) et QueryData(end_date=D[,form_types]) pour sec_filings/financials/earnings/insider_transactions. Garder la convention de date scanner D+1/D+3 (jours fériés marché) — jamais un freq=B pandas.

params.cache_key: encode end_date/as-of (ticker:asof), une entrée dédiée par date
params.forward_mode: as-of == aujourd hui (ou absent) → comportement inchangé (zéro régression)
params.date_convention: scanner D+1/D+3 (jours fériés marché) — PAS freq=B pandas

counter_example.why_bad: Fallback SILENCIEUX qui, à défaut de donnée PIT, sert le snapshot le plus récent (postérieur au setup) OU une valeur par défaut — avale l échec et fabrique du look-ahead. Chez nous = MCP HARD STOP: on STOPPE, on ne substitue JAMAIS un snapshot postérieur. findLatestCache/fetchScreener en mode PIT throw si aucun snapshot <= asof, jamais ne sert un fichier daté > asof.

evidence.note: Durcissement anti-look-ahead (idea #8 docs/research/ai-hedge-fund-ideas.md). Non déclenché par un trade, par une revue d architecture.

invalidation_conditions: Si un mode de rétro/PIT sert un enrichissement daté > as-of (fichier cache postérieur, ou API live rejouée en mode PIT) → bug infra, escalader.
rules.notes: Idea #8 (ai-hedge-fund). Implémenté: stockanalysis-fetcher.js (opt asof → clé type-country-asof, lecture seule bornée <= asof, throw si rien, findLatestCache maxDate) ; dtx-mcp-ingest.js --pit → data/dtx/<id>@<asof>.json (n écrase pas la staging live) ; price-cache.js encodait déjà la date dans le chemin (PIT natif). NE PAS copier le cache 100%-mémoire d ai-hedge-fund (explosion) — on garde staging fichier + cache OHLCV chaud dtx.

rules.rule: Pullback long UNIQUEMENT si le titre tient au-dessus d'une MM20 en hausse et ne fait pas de plus-bas sur 5 seances. La confiance de regime elevee ne suffit pas : un repli d'achat sur un titre deja en tendance baissiere (plus-bas successifs) est un couteau qui tombe.
invalidation_conditions: Si les lignes Pullback avec filtre de structure gardent un R moyen < -0,5R sur les 3 prochaines retros, escalader : la strategie Pullback elle-meme peut etre inadaptee au regime, pas seulement le filtre d'entree.
rules.notes: CAT pullback (entree 930,68 le 10/07) a passe la garde pullback-regime-confidence-gate (regime 0,82 > 60%) mais a perdu -9,56% / -1,38R en achetant le repli d'un titre en plus-bas successifs. Complete pullback-regime-confidence-gate (qui ne verifie que le regime, pas la structure de prix). Corrobore breakout-volatile-market-penalty (cassures faibles en tape mou). Sur ce meme scan, la selection etait propre : aucune dilution/drapeau/resultat surprise sur les 5 perdants ; le rate est directionnel (10 longs sur une cote qui a recule de 1,75%), pas un defaut de stock-picking.

rules.rule: Le filtre de resultats a plus ou moins 3 seances protege la DATE D'ENTREE, pas l'horizon de detention. Avec un horizon de 15 seances en saison de publication, une ligne entree le jour J traverse mecaniquement le trimestre de la moitie du panier. Toute publication tombant A L'INTERIEUR de l'horizon doit soit ecarter la ligne, soit raccourcir son horizon pour se clore avant la date, soit imposer une sortie la veille. En pic de saison, privilegier les societes ayant DEJA publie : le binaire est alors derriere la position, pas devant.

evidence.note: Scan 20260717 : 3 lignes sur 10 portaient un evenement dans l'horizon, toutes ayant passe le filtre a plus ou moins 3 seances a l'entree. BTSG stoppe le jour de sa publication (31/07, -18% sur la seance), CP stoppe au lendemain de la sienne (29/07), CHRW tue par une communication reglementaire item 7.01 du 23/07 (ecart de -6,7% le 24/07). CONTREFACTUEL MESURE : retirer ces 3 lignes porte le R moyen de -0.66 a -0.52, soit 22% de la perte expliquee. Les 78% restants sont hors evenement de resultats : la regle est necessaire et NON suffisante.

invalidation_conditions: Un scan de pleine saison sans aucune ligne portant un evenement dans l'horizon dont le R moyen reste inferieur a -0,4 : la regle ne serait alors pas le levier.
rules.notes: Trou identifie a la retro du scan 20260717. Portee MESUREE : 22% de la perte seulement (R moyen -0,66 -> -0,52 en retirant les 3 lignes). Les 78% restants relevent du calibrage du coussin de volatilite, cf. atr-cushion-verified-at-fill-not-published-level. Le scan 20260803 applique deja la parade pour une raison independante.

rules.rule: Le plancher de stop a 1,5 fois l'ATR doit etre verifie depuis entry_low (borne la plus defavorable de la zone), PAS depuis entry (borne haute publiee). Le remplissage se produit plus bas dans la fourchette que le niveau valide : le coussin est donc controle au point le plus genereux et consomme au point le moins genereux. Plus la fourchette d'entree est large, plus l'ecart se creuse. Corollaire : publier l'amplitude de la fourchette en pourcentage a cote du stop.

evidence.note: Scan 20260717. Coussin reel depuis le fill : stoppees 1,64x en moyenne, survivantes 2,24x. DEUX lignes sont parties SOUS le plancher reglementaire : BTSG 1,12x et DG 1,45x. BTSG valide pourtant 1,55x depuis son entry publie de 70,00 — elle s'est remplie a 69,00, bas de fourchette. Aucune violation de la regle telle qu'ecrite ; le defaut est dans le point de mesure. Meme classe que la divergence de convention R/R (validate depuis le milieu, qa depuis le haut) trouvee le 2026-08-02.

invalidation_conditions: Trois scans consecutifs ou le coussin mesure depuis entry_low est >= 1,5x sur toutes les lignes ET le taux de stop reste au-dessus de 60% : le calibrage ne serait alors pas le levier.
rules.notes: Trouve a la retro 20260717, seconde passe (la premiere avait conclu a tort a un mauvais pari directionnel : l'indice a monte de 0,50% sur la fenetre). NUANCE (panel senior, persona slop) : les distributions de coussin se CHEVAUCHENT entre 1,76 et 2,03 — CP a ete stoppe avec 2,03x, au-dessus d'EDU qui a gagne a 1,76x. Le coussin est un BIAIS, pas un discriminant. Severite abaissee de hard_block a selection_filter en consequence.

rules.rule: Une sortie sur stop doit etre comptabilisee a un prix REELLEMENT TRAITE dans la seance. Si la seance ouvre au-dela du stop et n'y revient jamais (plus haut de seance < stop pour un long), la sortie se fait A L'OUVERTURE, pas au stop. Comptabiliser au stop invente un prix que le marche n'a jamais cote et flatte mecaniquement le R et la note. La verification 'plus haut de seance >= stop' est obligatoire avant toute notation.

evidence.note: Retro 20260717, trouve par le panel senior (persona trader). CHRW le 24/07 : plus haut de seance 194,87 < stop 195,00 -> sortie reelle a l'ouverture 191,81, R -1,33 et non -1,00. HLN le 23/07 : plus haut 9,7349 < stop 9,80 -> sortie a 9,68, R -1,36 et non -1,00. Impact agrege : R moyen -0,66 -> -0,73, rendement -2,92% -> -3,19%, facteur de profit 0,23 -> 0,21. Booker au stop aurait flatte le R de 0,07 et la note.

invalidation_conditions: Aucune : c'est une contrainte d'integrite, pas une heuristique de marche.
rules.notes: Symetrique de fill-policy.js cote entree. Le module partage couvre l'ENTREE ; la SORTIE n'etait couverte nulle part et la premiere passe de cette retro a invente deux prix.

_closed_questions.question: Is the correlated-pool-exposure-cap rule detecting correlation pools automatically, or does it rely on a hardcoded list? Need dynamic correlation detection for new asset classes.
_closed_questions.verdict: Detection is NOT automatic — it is selection-time judgment. Proof 20260714: top-10 carried LRCX+WDC+KLAC (3 semis) + MTUM (semis-heavy) with no cap firing; all 5 gapped up then collapsed in the 3-day semis purge (would-be losses -5% to -14%, avoided only by the gap-up no-fill gate). The 20260715 scan applied the cap manually (regime_note: basket built ex-semis cluster, avg corr 0.13) and its non-semis picks fared better. Needs an encoded max-per-cluster check in validate-scan.js, not Phase 2 judgment.

_schema_methodology: v3.0 policy schema (2026-07-02): each rule now carries class (market_truth|process_rule), status (candidate|active|deprecated|rejected), evidence{sample_size,wins,losses,expectancy,period,tickers,clusters,source_retros}, confidence (0-1, effective/decayed value) + confidence_base (baseline set at last_validated_at, used for idempotent decay recompute), half_life_days (null for process_rule = never decays), expires_at (informational: date confidence would cross 0.30 if never revalidated). Engine: tools/lessons-engine.js --decay|--validate|--promote|--contradictions|--report. severity/rule fields are PRESERVED VERBATIM for backward compat with tools/validate-scan.js and .claude/commands/scanner.md which read them directly — do not rename or remove them.
